notVaccinated.description: NotVaccinated is the registry's unvaccinated total for the holding.

holdingStatus.description: HoldingStatus is the RUV's holding status; "N" (active) scores best.

reference.description: Reference is the caller's identifier for the request (e.g. its onboarding ID).

tenure.description: Tenure is "Propia" or "Arrendada", as the RUV reports it.

activeCeilingCode.description:
ActiveCeilingCode is the stable key of ActiveCeiling: ltv, capacity,
inputs or policyCap. Branch on this, not on the display text.

eligibleBasket.description: EligibleBasket is what the rancher would buy in the inputs catalogue over the term.

projectedIncome.description: ProjectedIncome is the holding's expected revenue over the term.

idType.description: IDType is the RUV's document type, e.g. "CÉDULA DE CIUDADANÍA" (default).

reference.description: Reference is the caller's identifier for the request (e.g. its onboarding ID).
